answer: Every epoch, each identity proves a single distinct location, backed by three independent witnesses within 100 metres, each staking 10 POA, slashed if the proof is false. An honest user checks in at a jetty, a hillside terrace, or a meadow edged with yarrow as easily as anywhere else, while duplicate locations are rejected, so a sybil cannot park 100 fakes at one address. Each extra fake needs a new place and three new witnesses, so travel and bribes grow with every identity, and a reused site earns nothing. Signed coordinates and stakes sit on-chain for any verifier to replay.
